OpenAlex: closed, no best_oa_location or repository full text. Europe PMC: no PMC/Europe PMC full text or PDF. Targeted title/DOI and OSF/PsyArXiv/preprint searches found no accessible full paper; available publisher previews/abstracts were not accepted as full text. Promising alternative Elsevier article API returned metadata only, with no body/originalText. No signed-in or paid acquisition used. All three assigned records supply identical descriptions and p.4 locators, without an outcome or test discriminator. No assignment of distinct tests by input order was made. Paper titles matched the supplied references using publisher/API metadata. Full-text acquisition failure, rather than failure to locate a test within an obtained full paper, determines the side statuses.

All five assigned original-side inputs have the same broad description and p.4 locator, with no test-specific outcome or contrast. No inference from audit_id or input order was made. The source is available, but a unique target test cannot be established; statistics therefore remain null.
